title: Global Scrollbar Styling
description: Style all scrollbars in the ui system — native overflow scrollbars and Radix ScrollArea custom scrollbars — using design tokens.
summary: Added global scrollbar design tokens and CSS in ui/styling/js/ui.css for native overflow scrollbars (Firefox scrollbar-color, WebKit pseudo-elements) and Radix Scrollable thumbs via data-slot rules. Updated ScrollBar sizing to use --scrollbar-size and moved thumb colors to CSS. Extended repo/lib/js/src/index.test.ts to assert scrollbar rules exist.
